race.title: Two-Mile Borris Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
race.verdict: This looks quite a shallow affair, so in-form LICEO makes most appeal on the back of several creditable efforts in defeat. Grennanstown Lady has upped her game of late and can make the placings again, whilst Daisy Fingall should do better now handicapping. LICEO (FR) GRENNANSTOWN LADY (IRE) DAISY FINGALL (IRE)
